scope: Theorem 1 of the manuscript “Ergodicity of triangular billiards with an irrational angle” (preprints/Ergodicity-of-triangular-billiards-with-an-irrational-angle-September-25-2026/Ergodicity-of-triangular-billiards-with-an-irrational-angle-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 150 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 200dd093e6de75c6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Q be the interior of a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with angles α, β, γ. Suppose that at least one of α/π, β/π, γ/π is irrational. The unit-speed billiard flow Φt, with specular reflection at the open sides, is ergodic on Q × S1 for the probability measure dµ = dA dθ 2π Area(Q) . Here trajectories hitting a vertex in either time direction are discarded. In particular, if a measurable set A satisfies µ(Φ−1 t A △ A) = 0 for every t ∈ R, then µ(A) ∈ {0, 1}.
